filesystem.description: Hardened filesystem server — read-only over scripts/, skills/ and screenshot/. Raise allow_write in mcp.json to allow writes.

fetch.description: Hardened fetch server — https only, SSRF-blocked, size and time capped. Add hosts to allow_private for internal endpoints.

sqlite.description: Hardened SQLite server — read-only, one statement per call, bound parameters, row/time caps. Starts through mcp/servers/python.mjs so any interpreter name (python3, python, py) works. Point the databases map at your own files.

supabase.description: Official Supabase remote MCP, read-only. Credentials live in .env (SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN, SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF) and are expanded at start — never written here. Writes and migrations need INFAGENT_ALLOW_SUPABASE_WRITES=1.

example.description: Bundled demo server (echo, add, now) — replace or remove it.

toolbox.description: Toolbox — every JS file under mcp/tools/ exports [{name, description, callback}] and becomes a callable tool in the chat. A tool file is trusted code (not sandboxed); use the code server for model-written code.

code.description: Code sandbox — run_javascript and run_python. Each run gets a fresh temp directory, an empty environment (no tokens), a time limit and capped output; Node's permission model blocks filesystem access outside it and child processes, and the Python runner refuses writes outside the sandbox, process creation and sockets. Network is blocked outright where user namespaces exist (Linux: unshare -n). Raise timeout_ms/max_output_bytes in the config if you need to.
